attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 as defined by ACCME, AAPA, AMA or AOA (50 of the 100 hours)
rules.alternatives: Current NCCPA certification satisfies the whole 100-hour requirement.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Board CE page: initial licensure issued during the current cycle is exempt for that cycle.
rules.audit_note: Attest in MELS at each annual renewal; upload documents only if selected for audit.

topics.who: PAs authorized to prescribe controlled substances: 5 hours on prescribing with emphasis on controlled substances, within the 100 hours

rules.notes: Two-year CE cycle starts July 1 of each even year (current: Jul 1, 2026-Jun 30, 2028). License renewed every year May 1-June 30, fee $150 plus convenience fee. The one-time DEA 8-hour training satisfies the Board controlled substance training.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code Part 2615, Chapter 1, Rule 1.9
